blockers.requirement: Authenticated finalized execution, raw signed transaction semantics and exact safe-wallet recovery credit remain unproven.
All terminal proof paths require independent observer provenance, freshness, reorg handling and protocol-specific finality evidence.
Real-key authority deployment, durable replay enforcement, least privilege and hostile-runtime isolation require an operational design and validation.
Independent security review, remaining live-SDK advisory disposition and release-owner approval are required before publication.
